title: 第5章 神秘的玄天宗主第6章 他还是废物一个
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: “你到底想干什么？”
林庆之咬牙切齿道。
“自然是来讨债的。”
秦云说道。
“讨债？讨什么债，我们林家根本不欠你什么！”
“不欠我什么？”
秦云冷哼一声，然后接着说道：“林淮月在我玄天宗待了两年，这两年来她从我玄天宗取走了大量的灵药。”
“那些灵药可是我玄天宗之物，而它们的下落我也早已查到，被送到你们林家来了。”
“除去那些灵药外，这两年来你林家吃穿用度，哪一点不是从我玄天宗拿的？”
“你们林家能达到现在的程度，是我玄天宗托举你，是我身为玄天宗少主给你们带来的便利。”
“你们吃我的喝我的，还说不欠我的？”
听完这些话，林庆之心虚的不敢与秦云对视。
林家能在这两年跻身洛城大家族的行列，就是因为吸了两年玄天宗的血，准确来说是吸了秦云的血。
不然，林家哪有这么多资源来提升家族实力。
“淮月带回的灵药和钱财都是你们愿意给的，又不是我们强迫你。
更何况，我女儿还陪了你两年。”
“以我女儿未来的潜力，你已经是大赚了。”
虽然秦云隐藏了实力，真正修为是凝气境第五重，但是林庆之还是看不起秦云。
这样的修为放在玄天宗也只是中上的水准罢了。
放在御兽宗的话，顶多也就是一个普通内宗弟子的水准而已，他的女儿可是御兽上人的亲传弟子，身份地位尊贵无比。
“我不想和你废话，要么将这两年吃下去的吐出来，要么我就立即带人灭掉你们林家。”
秦云冷冷说道。
“你敢！
我林家已经是御兽宗的附庸家族，你们敢对我们林家动手，御兽宗绝对不会放过你们。”
林庆之怒瞪秦云。
秦云却是笑道：“如果我对外宣称，你林家要杀我的话，你觉得御兽宗会冒着与我玄天宗大战来保你林家？”
“林庆之，你真以为你女儿在御兽宗的地位非常高？她只是有潜力被看重而已，并不是已经站在那个高度上了。”
“我玄天宗就算再差，也是洛城方圆三千里区域内排名第三的宗门。
“你觉得，御兽宗会为了你林家与我玄天宗大战吗？”
林庆之的脸色异常难看。
像御兽宗和玄天宗这种宗门，不到万不得已，是不会进行宗门大战的，更不会为了他林家和玄天宗大打出手。
“要不这样吧，将你们林家的所有灵药上交，念在昔年一点旧情的份上，我就不再追究了，怎么样？”
content_en:
"What on earth do you want to do?"
Lin Qingzhi gritted his teeth and said.
"Of course I'm here to collect debts."
Qin Yun said.
"Debt collection? What kind of debt are you collecting? Our Lin family doesn't owe you anything at all!"
"You don't owe me anything?"
Qin Yun snorted coldly, and then continued: "Lin Huaiyue has stayed in our Xuantian Sect for two years. In the past two years, she has taken a large number of elixirs from our Xuantian Sect."
"Those elixirs belong to my Xuantian Sect, and I have already found out their whereabouts, and they were sent to your Lin family."
"Except for those elixirs, what part of your Lin family's food and clothing expenses in the past two years did not come from our Xuantian Sect?"
"The fact that your Lin family has reached what you are now is because I, the Xuantian Sect, have entrusted you with your support, and it is because of the convenience that I, as the young master of the Xuantian Sect, have brought to you."
"You eat my food and drink my food, and you still say you don't owe me anything?"
After hearing these words, Lin Qingzhi felt so guilty that he did not dare to look at Qin Yun.
The Lin family has been able to join the ranks of the big families in Luo City in the past two years because they have sucked the blood of the Xuantian Sect for two years, or to be precise, they have sucked the blood of Qin Yun.
Otherwise, how could the Lin family have so many resources to enhance the family's strength.
"The elixirs and money Huaiyue brought back were all given by you willingly, and we did not force you.
What's more, my daughter has been with you for two years. "
"With my daughter's potential in the future, you've already made a lot of money."
Although Qin Yun hid his strength and his true cultivation was at the fifth level of Qi Condensation Realm, Lin Qingzhi still looked down upon Qin Yun.
Such a level of cultivation is only above average in Xuantian Sect.
In terms of the Beast Control Sect, she is at most the level of an ordinary inner sect disciple. His daughter is a direct disciple of Master Beast Control, and her status is extremely noble.
"I don't want to talk nonsense with you. Either I will spit out what I have eaten in the past two years, or I will lead people to destroy your Lin family immediately."
Qin Yun said coldly.
"You dare!
Our Lin family is already a vassal family of the Beast Control Sect. If you dare to attack our Lin family, the Beast Control Sect will never let you go. "
Lin Qingzhi glared at Qin Yun.
Qin Yun smiled and said: "If I declare to the outside world that your Lin family wants to kill me, do you think the Beast Control Sect will risk a fight with my Xuantian Sect to protect your Lin family?"
"Lin Qingzhi, do you really think your daughter's status in the Beast Control Sect is very high? She just has the potential to be valued, not that she has already reached that level."
"No matter how bad our Xuantian Sect is, it is still the third-ranked sect within a three thousand mile radius of Luo City.
"Do you think the Beast Control Sect will fight with my Xuantian Sect for your Lin family? "
Lin Qingzhi's face looked extremely ugly.
Sects like the Beast Control Sect and the Xuantian Sect would not engage in sect wars unless absolutely necessary, let alone fight between the Lin family and the Xuantian Sect because of him.
"How about this, hand over all the elixirs of your Lin family, and for the sake of old love, I won't pursue it anymore, how about that? "
title_en: Chapter 5 The mysterious Xuantian Sect Master Chapter 6 He is still a loser
